proposedSql:
-- DESIGN DRAFT (STUDIO-OBS-015, @data-engineer). Not installed. Proposed path when the S4 window
-- closes: backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V21__guided_session_replaying_prefix.sql
-- (Flyway description "guided session replaying prefix").
--
-- STUDIO-OBS-015: guided session state REPLAYING_PREFIX. Forward-only after V19 (OBS-014) and
-- V20 (OBS-013); V12-V20 are not edited. Ruling: docs/qa/evidence/STUDIO-OBS-015/
-- t0-architect-rulings.json ruling4.ownership.ddlFinding (state) and ruling3.mechanism[2]
-- (the model gateway is never reserved while state = REPLAYING_PREFIX).
--
-- Part A (required). Replace the V14 state CHECK by its explicit name. The name stays
-- ck_guided_session_state_v3: the suffix is the guided contract generation (contracts/v3,
-- session schemaVersion 3), and C3b adds REPLAYING_PREFIX inside v3, so no new generation exists.
-- Only this named constraint is touched. The four auto-named CHECKs on studio_guided_sessions
-- (document->>'sessionId'/'scopeHash'/'state' and scope.principalId equalities) are not named and
-- not changed. REPLAYING_PREFIX is NON-terminal: every terminal list in V14/V15/V17/V19 and Java
-- is an explicit list of the six terminal states, so a new state is non-terminal everywhere
-- without editing any of them (V14 tr_guided_identity, V15 evidence guard, V17 secret release,
-- V19 prune guard, prune function, live-CSI index, GuidedCsiBudget.TERMINAL).
--
-- Part B (optional defence in depth, @data-engineer discretion per story T3). No model attempt
-- row can be inserted while the session is REPLAYING_PREFIX, and the session cannot enter
-- REPLAYING_PREFIX while a live (RESERVED or CALLING) attempt exists. Together these make
-- "no reserved gateway call while REPLAYING_PREFIX" a database invariant. New function and two
-- new triggers; the V14/V19 function studio_guided_translation_attempt_guard is NOT replaced.
-- Locking: the session row is locked FOR UPDATE, as the V15 guards do; GuidedSessionService
-- .translationTransaction already holds that lock (GuidedSessionRepository.lock), so no new
-- lock order is introduced.

ALTER TABLE studio_guided_sessions
 DROP CONSTRAINT ck_guided_session_state_v3,
 ADD CONSTRAINT ck_guided_session_state_v3 CHECK (state IN ('PREPARING','REPLAYING_PREFIX','OBSERVING',
  'PROPOSING','ACTING','AWAITING_CLARIFICATION','FINALIZING','SUCCEEDED','PUBLICATION_CONFLICT','FAILED',
  'UNKNOWN_OUTCOME','CANCELLED','EXPIRED'));

CREATE FUNCTION studio_guided_replaying_prefix_guard() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE current_state varchar(32);
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='studio_guided_model_attempts' THEN
  SELECT state INTO current_state FROM studio_guided_sessions WHERE session_id=NEW.session_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF current_state='REPLAYING_PREFIX' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'guided model attempt refused while replaying prefix';
  END IF;
 ELSIF NEW.state='REPLAYING_PREFIX' AND OLD.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'REPLAYING_PREFIX'
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM studio_guided_model_attempts
   WHERE session_id=NEW.session_id AND status IN ('RESERVED','CALLING')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'guided session cannot replay prefix with a live model attempt';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER tr_guided_replaying_prefix_attempt BEFORE INSERT ON studio_guided_model_attempts
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION studio_guided_replaying_prefix_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER tr_guided_replaying_prefix_entry BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON studio_guided_sessions
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION studio_guided_replaying_prefix_guard();
decisions: [AUTO-DECISION] Keep the constraint name ck_guided_session_state_v3 or rename to _v4? -> Keep (reason: _v3 is the guided contract generation, not a revision counter; C3b adds REPLAYING_PREFIX inside contracts/v3 (ruling4 C3b) and ADR-SC-005 D-A allows one generation. Keeping the name also leaves GuidedSecretLoginMigrationTest.java:280 hasMessageContaining("ck_guided_session_state_v3") valid.)

[AUTO-DECISION] DROP and ADD in one ALTER TABLE statement -> Yes (reason: one ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, no window without a state CHECK; the new set is a strict superset so validation of existing rows cannot fail). NOT VALID + VALIDATE gives nothing inside Flyway's single transaction and is not used.
[AUTO-DECISION] Place REPLAYING_PREFIX in the CHECK list after PREPARING -> list order is cosmetic for IN(...); placed in lifecycle order for readability.

[AUTO-DECISION] Include Part B (optional defence in depth)? -> Yes, as a separable block (reason: the story leaves it to @data-engineer; it turns ruling3 'gateway never reserved while REPLAYING_PREFIX' into a DB invariant at the cost of one function and two triggers). Root may drop Part B by deleting everything after the ALTER TABLE; Part A stands alone.

[AUTO-DECISION] Part B covers the entry side too (refuse entering REPLAYING_PREFIX while a RESERVED/CALLING attempt exists) -> Yes (reason: an insert-only guard leaves a live reservation that was made before the transition; 'never reserved while' needs both sides).

[AUTO-DECISION] Replace V14/V19 studio_guided_translation_attempt_guard instead of a new function? -> No (reason: that function is BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE only and V19 owns its current body; a separate BEFORE INSERT function leaves OBS-014's prune semantics byte-identical).

[AUTO-DECISION] Add baseRevisionId/firstLearnStepId to the V14 identity-immutability trigger? -> No (reason: not required by the rulings; the document key names belong to C3b, which has not landed; the base revision is already pinned by studio_guided_publication_bases.document.confirmedRevisionId, a closed key set checked against ui_tests.confirmed_revision_id at V15__publication.sql:93-112). Candidate follow-up after C3b if @architect wants it.

[AUTO-DECISION] Encode allowed transitions (e.g. only PREPARING -> REPLAYING_PREFIX, one-way exit) in the DB? -> No (reason: the T3 state machine is not designed yet; the DB keeps only the invariants the rulings state).

constraintsT3MustRespect: studio_publication_base_guard (V15__publication.sql:93) requires session state PREPARING, owner unclaimed, fence 0 and no assignment/materialization/action/attempt when the publication base is inserted. A session therefore cannot be INSERTed directly in REPLAYING_PREFIX if start also writes the base; it must be created PREPARING and enter REPLAYING_PREFIX later.
GuidedAssignmentStore.java:37 claims only a PREPARING session, so REPLAYING_PREFIX is entered after the worker claim.

With Part B, GuidedTranslationStore.runnable() (GuidedTranslationStore.java:1293-1299) still selects REPLAYING_PREFIX sessions (it filters only terminal states and three continuations). T3 must exclude them there; otherwise the worker's reservation raises 'guided model attempt refused while replaying prefix' (fail closed, but noisy).

rollbackAndForward.policy: Forward-only (ARCH.md:123, ADR-SC-005 D-B). No Flyway undo. V21 is never edited after it is installed anywhere; a defect is fixed by V22.
rollbackAndForward.devDatabases: D-B: no shared environment was ever deployed and dev databases are recreated, so the practical rollback before release is to drop the V21 file and recreate.
rollbackAndForward.compensatingV22Verified: On the scratch database inside a rolled-back transaction: the guard passed (no REPLAYING_PREFIX rows), both triggers and the function dropped, and md5 of all studio_guided_sessions constraint definitions equalled a fresh V1-V20 database (518e1945b40fce0272d6a697b1f828d6 on both).
rollbackAndForward.compensationRefuses: Any session row in REPLAYING_PREFIX (the restored CHECK would reject it, and terminal rows cannot be rewritten by the V14 trigger anyway). Such sessions must reach a terminal state first; REPLAYING_PREFIX is non-terminal, so expire/cancel can move them.
rollbackAndForward.partBOnly: Part B can be removed alone by a forward migration dropping the two triggers and the function; Part A is unaffected.
rollbackAndForward.locking: ALTER TABLE takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on studio_guided_sessions and scans it to validate the superset CHECK; with dev-only data this is negligible. Part B adds one indexed EXISTS (attempts by session_id, PK prefix) on state changes into REPLAYING_PREFIX and one session-row lock per attempt insert, which the Java transaction already holds.
